card.name: Words mid-clause in cautionary drug sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words (be, this, not, the, at) and mid-name pieces of drug names, inside a clause that describes an effect or a precaution in a drug label. The next word is usually a verb or a noun in the middle of the clause.

modes.label: Linking words in precaution clauses
modes.description: A small word such as be, this, not, the or at sits inside a clause about avoiding or causing an effect.
modes.example: Overdosage by ocular instillation is unlikely because any excess solution should<< be>> quickly expelled from the conjunctival sac

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a drug name, such as uron in vecuronium or or in cyclosporine.
